title: Host Damage Protection (HostCover) Schedule of Limits by Level
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** sets, for each of its six levels, how much can be paid on one claim, how much can be paid in one plan year, the level's deductible, how many claims can be paid in a plan year and the smallest claimed amount the plan accepts. The figures below are the level's own terms and apply to every plan held at that level.

## Schedule

| HostCover level | Per-claim limit (USD) | Annual aggregate limit (USD) | Deductible (USD) | Most claims paid per plan year | Minimum claimed amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 500.00 | 2 | 100.00 |
| HostCover Standard | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 250.00 | 4 | 50.00 |
| HostCover Plus | 100000.00 | 200000.00 | 250.00 | 6 | 50.00 |
| HostCover Premier | 500000.00 | 1000000.00 | 100.00 | 8 | 50.00 |
| HostCover Elite | 1000000.00 | 2000000.00 | 0.00 | 12 | 0.00 |
| HostCover Estate | 3000000.00 | 5000000.00 | 0.00 | 12 | 0.00 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Per-claim limit**: the most paid on one claim.
- **Annual aggregate limit**: the most paid, net, on all claims of the plan in one plan year.
- **Deductible**: the deductible amount of the level, in USD.
- **Most claims paid per plan year**: the most claims paid on the plan in one plan year.
- **Minimum claimed amount**: the smallest claimed amount the plan accepts.

## Notes on reading the schedule

1. The figures belong to the HostCover level, not to the host: a host with plans at two different levels has two different sets of limits.
2. On HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate the deductible is 0.00 and the minimum claimed amount is 0.00; on those levels no claimed amount falls below the minimum.
3. Moving up the ladder never lowers a limit: each level's per-claim limit, annual aggregate limit and paid-claim count is at least that of the level below it, and the deductible never rises.

## Reading examples (hypothetical claims)

- A claim of 80.00 on a HostCover Essential plan is below that level's minimum of 100.00; the same 80.00 on a HostCover Standard plan meets its minimum of 50.00.
- A HostCover Plus plan can have at most 6 claims paid in one plan year; a HostCover Premier plan, at most 8.
